source_evidence: Exact player 'keep descending' authorizes following the established rope passage to its next accessible chamber. Fenar independently checks visible anchor and rope condition and uses her retained climb adaptation to lead; passage is a steep but ordinary rough 25ft descent with reliable footholds, intact rope and anchor, not a free-hanging shaft or hazardous failed check. V and Cirren follow with rope and footholds, shield Light maintained, no ability check needed for ordinary assisted climbing, no feature or consumable spent. D338~06:16–06:19: reach lower working gallery approximately 70ft of passage from entrance, about25ft below upper chamber, 35ft long x15ft wide, 7–10ft high, two rough timber roof props near widened excavation, ore vein visibly continues through wall at this level; three short blind trial cuts end in solid worked stone and a deeper descending natural crack at the far end has rubble tightly packed across its opening. A simple rope basket and small wooden hand-winch for lifting ore sit near foot of descent. Approximately six filled baskets of unassayed gray metallic-looking rock arranged next to winch, no custody or value assigned. No additional creature observed, no sound of activity, no evidence of another occupied camp, ancient seat, magical object or hidden treasure. Cirren Detect Magic senses no unfamiliar magic within effective range; concentration expires naturally at~06:20 if no further extension. Fenar notes the packed rubble might be deliberate or a response to unstable rock; cannot tell without examination; no digging or moving props authorized. This is end of readily accessible worked mine, not proof of no deeper void or concealed path. Existing 7 dead Derro, prospecting evidence and unknown mineral/assay/title unchanged. No new roll, damage, loot transfer, feature use, supplies, healing or expenditure. Pause before disturbing rubble or conducting further search.
